descVi: Giao tiếp độc lập, diễn đạt quan điểm cá nhân và đọc hiểu tin tức — IELTS 5.5–6.0.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ nhấn mạnh; đứng trước tính từ hoặc dùng độc lập để đồng ý mạnh
words.meaningVi: tuyệt đối, hoàn toàn; chắc chắn rồi (đồng ý dứt khoát)
words.definitionEn: trạng từ nhấn mạnh; đứng trước tính từ hoặc dùng độc lập để đồng ý mạnh
words.exampleDailyEn: The food was absolutely delicious.
words.exampleIeltsEn: I am absolutely certain that I locked the door.
examples: The food was absolutely delicious.
I am absolutely certain that I locked the door.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; thường đi với year, results, success
words.meaningVi: thuộc học thuật, thuộc việc học hành; giỏi lý thuyết
words.definitionEn: tính từ; thường đi với year, results, success
words.exampleDailyEn: Her academic results improved a lot this year.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He left the academic world to start a business.
examples: Her academic results improved a lot this year.
He left the academic world to start a business.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ chính; access to something; cũng là động từ: access a file
words.meaningVi: sự tiếp cận, quyền truy cập; (v) truy cập, vào được
words.definitionEn: danh từ chính; access to something; cũng là động từ: access a file
words.exampleDailyEn: Students have free access to the library.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You can access your account from any phone.
examples: Students have free access to the library.
You can access your account from any phone.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ không đếm được trong tiếng Anh-Anh; thường đi với find/provide
words.meaningVi: chỗ ở, nơi ăn chốn ở
words.definitionEn: danh từ không đếm được trong tiếng Anh-Anh; thường đi với find/provide
words.exampleDailyEn: The hotel offers cheap accommodation for students.
words.exampleIeltsEn: We need to find accommodation before the trip.
examples: The hotel offers cheap accommodation for students.
We need to find accommodation before the trip.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; bank account; take something into account = cân nhắc điều gì
words.meaningVi: tài khoản (ngân hàng, mạng); bản tường thuật
words.definitionEn: danh từ; bank account; take something into account = cân nhắc điều gì
words.exampleDailyEn: She opened a new bank account last week.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He gave the police a full account of the accident.
examples: She opened a new bank account last week.
He gave the police a full account of the accident.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a sense of achievement = cảm giác tự hào vì đạt được
words.meaningVi: thành tựu, thành tích; việc làm được điều khó
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a sense of achievement = cảm giác tự hào vì đạt được
words.exampleDailyEn: Winning the prize was a huge achievement for her.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Finishing the marathon gave him a real sense of achievement.
examples: Winning the prize was a huge achievement for her.
Finishing the marathon gave him a real sense of achievement.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ thân mật; ad for something; put/place an ad
words.meaningVi: quảng cáo (cách nói ngắn, danh từ)
words.definitionEn: danh từ thân mật; ad for something; put/place an ad
words.exampleDailyEn: I saw an ad for the concert online.
words.exampleIeltsEn: They placed an ad in the local newspaper.
examples: I saw an ad for the concert online.
They placed an ad in the local newspaper.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; in addition (to) = thêm vào đó / ngoài... ra
words.meaningVi: sự thêm vào; phép cộng
words.definitionEn: danh từ; in addition (to) = thêm vào đó / ngoài... ra
words.exampleDailyEn: In addition to English, she speaks French and Spanish.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The new baby is a lovely addition to the family.
examples: In addition to English, she speaks French and Spanish.
The new baby is a lovely addition to the family.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; admire somebody for something
words.meaningVi: ngưỡng mộ, thán phục; ngắm nhìn thích thú
words.definitionEn: động từ; admire somebody for something
words.exampleDailyEn: I really admire her for staying so calm.
words.exampleIeltsEn: They stood on the hill admiring the sunset.
examples: I really admire her for staying so calm.
They stood on the hill admiring the sunset.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; admit (doing) something; trái nghĩa với deny
words.meaningVi: thừa nhận, nhận lỗi; cho vào, nhận vào (viện, trường)
words.definitionEn: động từ; admit (doing) something; trái nghĩa với deny
words.exampleDailyEn: He finally admitted that he was wrong.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She was admitted to hospital after the fall.
examples: He finally admitted that he was wrong.
She was admitted to hospital after the fall.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; advanced level/course; nói về công nghệ hoặc trình độ
words.meaningVi: nâng cao, trình độ cao; tiên tiến, hiện đại
words.definitionEn: tính từ; advanced level/course; nói về công nghệ hoặc trình độ
words.exampleDailyEn: She is taking an advanced English course.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The factory uses very advanced technology.
examples: She is taking an advanced English course.
The factory uses very advanced technology.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; advise somebody to do something; chú ý chữ s khác với danh từ advice
words.meaningVi: khuyên, khuyên bảo
words.definitionEn: động từ; advise somebody to do something; chú ý chữ s khác với danh từ advice
words.exampleDailyEn: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.
words.exampleIeltsEn: I'd advise you to book the tickets early.
examples: The doctor advised me to rest for a week.
I'd advise you to book the tickets early.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; thường dùng với can/could; can't afford to do something
words.meaningVi: có đủ khả năng (tiền/thời gian) để làm gì
words.definitionEn: động từ; thường dùng với can/could; can't afford to do something
words.exampleDailyEn: We can't afford a new car this year.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She couldn't afford to take a day off work.
examples: We can't afford a new car this year.
She couldn't afford to take a day off work.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; aged + số = ở tuổi; the aged = người già
words.meaningVi: ở độ tuổi là; già, cao tuổi
words.definitionEn: tính từ; aged + số = ở tuổi; the aged = người già
words.exampleDailyEn: The class is for children aged six to ten.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He looked after his aged grandmother.
examples: The class is for children aged six to ten.
He looked after his aged grandmother.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; travel agent, estate agent; secret agent
words.meaningVi: đại lý, người đại diện; điệp viên
words.definitionEn: danh từ; travel agent, estate agent; secret agent
words.exampleDailyEn: A travel agent helped us plan the whole trip.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The film is about a secret agent in Paris.
examples: A travel agent helped us plan the whole trip.
The film is about a secret agent in Paris.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; reach/sign an agreement; in agreement with
words.meaningVi: sự đồng ý, sự nhất trí; thỏa thuận, hiệp định
words.definitionEn: danh từ; reach/sign an agreement; in agreement with
words.exampleDailyEn: The two countries signed a trade agreement.
words.exampleIeltsEn: After hours of talking, they finally reached an agreement.
examples: The two countries signed a trade agreement.
After hours of talking, they finally reached an agreement.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ; ahead of = trước, hơn; go ahead = cứ tiếp tục
words.meaningVi: ở phía trước; trước (thời gian); tiến lên
words.definitionEn: trạng từ; ahead of = trước, hơn; go ahead = cứ tiếp tục
words.exampleDailyEn: The road ahead was blocked by snow.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She finished the project two days ahead of time.
examples: The road ahead was blocked by snow.
She finished the project two days ahead of time.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ, viết tắt; thường dùng như danh từ không đếm được
words.meaningVi: trí tuệ nhân tạo (artificial intelligence)
words.definitionEn: danh từ, viết tắt; thường dùng như danh từ không đếm được
words.exampleDailyEn: Many companies now use AI to answer customer questions.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He is studying how AI can help doctors.
examples: Many companies now use AI to answer customer questions.
He is studying how AI can help doctors.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ chính; aim to do / aim at; danh từ: the aim of something
words.meaningVi: nhắm tới, hướng tới, cố đạt; (n) mục tiêu, mục đích
words.definitionEn: động từ chính; aim to do / aim at; danh từ: the aim of something
words.exampleDailyEn: We aim to finish the building by June.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Her main aim is to become a nurse.
examples: We aim to finish the building by June.
Her main aim is to become a nurse.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; set an alarm; fire alarm; raise the alarm
words.meaningVi: sự báo động, nỗi lo sợ; chuông báo, đồng hồ báo thức
words.definitionEn: danh từ; set an alarm; fire alarm; raise the alarm
words.exampleDailyEn: I set my alarm for six o'clock.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night.
examples: I set my alarm for six o'clock.
The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a new album; a photo album
words.meaningVi: đĩa nhạc, an-bum; tập ảnh
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a new album; a photo album
words.exampleDailyEn: The band released their new album last month.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She keeps all her holiday photos in an album.
examples: The band released their new album last month.
She keeps all her holiday photos in an album.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ không đếm được; drink alcohol; low in alcohol
words.meaningVi: rượu, cồn, đồ uống có cồn
words.definitionEn: danh từ không đếm được; drink alcohol; low in alcohol
words.exampleDailyEn: The restaurant doesn't serve alcohol to teenagers.
words.exampleIeltsEn: This drink contains no alcohol.
examples: The restaurant doesn't serve alcohol to teenagers.
This drink contains no alcohol.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; alcoholic drink; trái nghĩa non-alcoholic
words.meaningVi: có cồn, chứa cồn; (n) người nghiện rượu
words.definitionEn: tính từ; alcoholic drink; trái nghĩa non-alcoholic
words.exampleDailyEn: They offered both alcoholic and soft drinks at the party.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He stopped drinking after years as an alcoholic.
examples: They offered both alcoholic and soft drinks at the party.
He stopped drinking after years as an alcoholic.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; amazed at/by; amazed that
words.meaningVi: kinh ngạc, sửng sốt (theo hướng tốt)
words.definitionEn: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; amazed at/by; amazed that
words.exampleDailyEn: I was amazed at how quickly she learned to drive.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Everyone was amazed by the beautiful view.
examples: I was amazed at how quickly she learned to drive.
Everyone was amazed by the beautiful view.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a lifelong ambition; achieve/realize an ambition
words.meaningVi: tham vọng, hoài bão; điều mong muốn đạt được
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a lifelong ambition; achieve/realize an ambition
words.exampleDailyEn: Her ambition is to travel to every continent.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He finally achieved his ambition of opening a café.
examples: Her ambition is to travel to every continent.
He finally achieved his ambition of opening a café.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; ambitious person; ambitious plan/project
words.meaningVi: đầy tham vọng, nhiều hoài bão; (kế hoạch) lớn, cao
words.definitionEn: tính từ; ambitious person; ambitious plan/project
words.exampleDailyEn: She is young and very ambitious.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The company has ambitious plans for next year.
examples: She is young and very ambitious.
The company has ambitious plans for next year.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ (Anh-Anh; Anh-Mỹ viết analyze); analyse data/results
words.meaningVi: phân tích, xem xét kỹ
words.definitionEn: động từ (Anh-Anh; Anh-Mỹ viết analyze); analyse data/results
words.exampleDailyEn: Scientists analyse the data before writing their report.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Let's analyse what went wrong in the match.
examples: Scientists analyse the data before writing their report.
Let's analyse what went wrong in the match.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; số nhiều analyses; a detailed analysis of something
words.meaningVi: sự phân tích, bài phân tích
words.definitionEn: danh từ; số nhiều analyses; a detailed analysis of something
words.exampleDailyEn: The report gives a clear analysis of the problem.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Her analysis of the poem was very interesting.
examples: The report gives a clear analysis of the problem.
Her analysis of the poem was very interesting.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; announce (that); announce something to somebody
words.meaningVi: thông báo, loan báo công khai
words.definitionEn: động từ; announce (that); announce something to somebody
words.exampleDailyEn: The airline announced that the flight was delayed.
words.exampleIeltsEn: They announced their wedding on social media.
examples: The airline announced that the flight was delayed.
They announced their wedding on social media.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; make an announcement
words.meaningVi: thông báo, lời tuyên bố
words.definitionEn: danh từ; make an announcement
words.exampleDailyEn: The teacher made an important announcement before class.
words.exampleIeltsEn: We are waiting for the government's announcement.
examples: The teacher made an important announcement before class.
We are waiting for the government's announcement.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; it annoys me when/that; gần nghĩa với irritate
words.meaningVi: làm phiền, làm bực mình, chọc tức
words.definitionEn: động từ; it annoys me when/that; gần nghĩa với irritate
words.exampleDailyEn: It really annoys me when people are late.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Stop making that noise, you're annoying everyone.
examples: It really annoys me when people are late.
Stop making that noise, you're annoying everyone.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; annoyed with somebody; annoyed about something
words.meaningVi: bực mình, khó chịu
words.definitionEn: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; annoyed with somebody; annoyed about something
words.exampleDailyEn: She was annoyed with her brother for breaking her phone.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He got annoyed about the long queue.
examples: She was annoyed with her brother for breaking her phone.
He got annoyed about the long queue.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ chỉ tính chất; phân biệt với annoyed (cảm xúc người)
words.meaningVi: gây khó chịu, phiền phức (chỉ sự vật/sự việc)
words.definitionEn: tính từ chỉ tính chất; phân biệt với annoyed (cảm xúc người)
words.exampleDailyEn: That dripping tap is so annoying.
words.exampleIeltsEn: It's annoying when the internet keeps cutting out.
examples: That dripping tap is so annoying.
It's annoying when the internet keeps cutting out.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ; take something apart = tháo rời; live apart
words.meaningVi: cách xa, tách rời; apart from = ngoài... ra, trừ
words.definitionEn: trạng từ; take something apart = tháo rời; live apart
words.exampleDailyEn: The two towns are ten kilometres apart.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Apart from Sunday, I work every day.
examples: The two towns are ten kilometres apart.
Apart from Sunday, I work every day.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; apologize to somebody for something (Anh-Anh cũng viết apologise)
words.meaningVi: xin lỗi
words.definitionEn: động từ; apologize to somebody for something (Anh-Anh cũng viết apologise)
words.exampleDailyEn: He apologized to his teacher for being late.
words.exampleIeltsEn: I must apologize for the mess in the kitchen.
examples: He apologized to his teacher for being late.
I must apologize for the mess in the kitchen.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; application for something; fill in/submit an application
words.meaningVi: đơn xin (việc, học); sự ứng dụng; ứng dụng (phần mềm)
words.definitionEn: danh từ; application for something; fill in/submit an application
words.exampleDailyEn: She sent her application for the job yesterday.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You can download the application on your phone.
examples: She sent her application for the job yesterday.
You can download the application on your phone.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; make/have an appointment with somebody
words.meaningVi: cuộc hẹn (với bác sĩ, luật sư...); sự bổ nhiệm
words.definitionEn: danh từ; make/have an appointment with somebody
words.exampleDailyEn: I have a dentist's appointment at three o'clock.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You need to make an appointment to see the manager.
examples: I have a dentist's appointment at three o'clock.
You need to make an appointment to see the manager.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; I'd appreciate it if...; appreciate something
words.meaningVi: biết ơn, trân trọng; đánh giá cao, hiểu rõ giá trị
words.definitionEn: động từ; I'd appreciate it if...; appreciate something
words.exampleDailyEn: I really appreciate all your help.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You can't appreciate the music until you hear it live.
examples: I really appreciate all your help.
You can't appreciate the music until you hear it live.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ trang trọng hơn about; đứng trước con số
words.meaningVi: khoảng, xấp xỉ, gần bằng
words.definitionEn: trạng từ trang trọng hơn about; đứng trước con số
words.exampleDailyEn: The journey takes approximately two hours.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Approximately 500 people attended the concert.
examples: The journey takes approximately two hours.
Approximately 500 people attended the concert.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ chính; arrest somebody for something; be under arrest
words.meaningVi: bắt giữ (người phạm tội); (n) sự bắt giữ
words.definitionEn: động từ chính; arrest somebody for something; be under arrest
words.exampleDailyEn: The police arrested two men after the robbery.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She was placed under arrest at the airport.
examples: The police arrested two men after the robbery.
She was placed under arrest at the airport.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; on arrival = khi vừa đến; trái nghĩa departure
words.meaningVi: sự đến nơi; người hoặc vật mới đến
words.definitionEn: danh từ; on arrival = khi vừa đến; trái nghĩa departure
words.exampleDailyEn: Our arrival was delayed by heavy traffic.
words.exampleIeltsEn: On arrival at the hotel, we were given a free drink.
examples: Our arrival was delayed by heavy traffic.
On arrival at the hotel, we were given a free drink.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; hand in/do an assignment; a difficult assignment
words.meaningVi: bài tập được giao; nhiệm vụ, công việc được phân
words.definitionEn: danh từ; hand in/do an assignment; a difficult assignment
words.exampleDailyEn: I have to hand in my English assignment on Friday.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The reporter was sent on a dangerous assignment abroad.
examples: I have to hand in my English assignment on Friday.
The reporter was sent on a dangerous assignment abroad.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ trang trọng hơn help; assist somebody with something
words.meaningVi: trợ giúp, hỗ trợ
words.definitionEn: động từ trang trọng hơn help; assist somebody with something
words.exampleDailyEn: A nurse assisted the doctor during the operation.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Can you assist me with these heavy bags?
examples: A nurse assisted the doctor during the operation.
Can you assist me with these heavy bags?

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a friendly/relaxed atmosphere; the Earth's atmosphere
words.meaningVi: bầu không khí (cảm giác nơi chốn); khí quyển
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a friendly/relaxed atmosphere; the Earth's atmosphere
words.exampleDailyEn: The little restaurant has a warm, friendly atmosphere.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Pollution is damaging the Earth's atmosphere.
examples: The little restaurant has a warm, friendly atmosphere.
Pollution is damaging the Earth's atmosphere.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; attach something to something; attach a file to an email
words.meaningVi: gắn, buộc, đính kèm
words.definitionEn: động từ; attach something to something; attach a file to an email
words.exampleDailyEn: Please attach your photo to the form.
words.exampleIeltsEn: I've attached the report to this email.
examples: Please attach your photo to the form.

words.meaningVi: sự tương phản, sự đối lập
words.definitionEn: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ; in contrast to/with; by contrast
words.exampleDailyEn: There is a sharp contrast between the rich and the poor here.
words.exampleIeltsEn: In contrast to his brother, he is very quiet.
examples: There is a sharp contrast between the rich and the poor here.
In contrast to his brother, he is very quiet.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; convenient for somebody; trái nghĩa với inconvenient
words.meaningVi: thuận tiện, tiện lợi
words.definitionEn: tính từ; convenient for somebody; trái nghĩa với inconvenient
words.exampleDailyEn: The shop is very convenient because it opens late.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Is Monday a convenient day for our meeting?
examples: The shop is very convenient because it opens late.
Is Monday a convenient day for our meeting?

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; convince somebody to do something; convince somebody that
words.meaningVi: thuyết phục; làm cho tin
words.definitionEn: động từ; convince somebody to do something; convince somebody that
words.exampleDailyEn: I couldn't convince him to change his mind.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She convinced me that the plan would work.
examples: I couldn't convince him to change his mind.
She convinced me that the plan would work.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a Halloween costume; so với clothes (quần áo thường)
words.meaningVi: trang phục (hóa trang, biểu diễn)
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a Halloween costume; so với clothes (quần áo thường)
words.exampleDailyEn: The children wore animal costumes to the party.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Each dancer had a bright, colourful costume.
examples: The children wore animal costumes to the party.
Each dancer had a bright, colourful costume.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a country cottage = nhà nhỏ ở quê
words.meaningVi: nhà tranh, nhà nhỏ ở nông thôn
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a country cottage = nhà nhỏ ở quê
words.exampleDailyEn: They spent the weekend in a cottage by the sea.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The old cottage had a thatched roof and a small garden.
examples: They spent the weekend in a cottage by the sea.
The old cottage had a thatched roof and a small garden.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; a cotton shirt = áo cotton
words.meaningVi: bông, vải cotton
words.definitionEn: danh từ; không đếm được; a cotton shirt = áo cotton
words.exampleDailyEn: This T-shirt is made of pure cotton.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Cotton is grown in many warm countries.
examples: This T-shirt is made of pure cotton.
Cotton is grown in many warm countries.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; in the countryside = ở miền quê
words.meaningVi: vùng nông thôn, miền quê
words.definitionEn: danh từ; không đếm được; in the countryside = ở miền quê
words.exampleDailyEn: We love walking in the countryside at weekends.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Life in the countryside is slower and quieter.
examples: We love walking in the countryside at weekends.
Life in the countryside is slower and quieter.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; go to court = ra tòa; a tennis court
words.meaningVi: tòa án; sân (thể thao)
words.definitionEn: danh từ; go to court = ra tòa; a tennis court
words.exampleDailyEn: The case will go to court next month.
words.exampleIeltsEn: They played two sets on the tennis court.
examples: The case will go to court next month.
They played two sets on the tennis court.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ (che phủ); take cover = tìm chỗ trú
words.meaningVi: bìa (sách); vỏ bọc; nơi trú ẩn
words.definitionEn: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ (che phủ); take cover = tìm chỗ trú
words.exampleDailyEn: The book has a beautiful cover.
words.exampleIeltsEn: When the rain started, we took cover under a tree.
examples: The book has a beautiful cover.
When the rain started, we took cover under a tree.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; covered in/with something = phủ đầy
words.meaningVi: được che phủ, phủ đầy
words.definitionEn: tính từ; covered in/with something = phủ đầy
words.exampleDailyEn: By morning the fields were covered in snow.
words.exampleIeltsEn: His hands were covered with paint.
examples: By morning the fields were covered in snow.
His hands were covered with paint.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; cruel to somebody/something; trái nghĩa với kind
words.meaningVi: tàn nhẫn, độc ác, tàn bạo
words.definitionEn: tính từ; cruel to somebody/something; trái nghĩa với kind
words.exampleDailyEn: It is cruel to leave a dog alone all day.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The king was famous for his cruel punishments.
examples: It is cruel to leave a dog alone all day.
The king was famous for his cruel punishments.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; cultural differences = khác biệt văn hóa
words.meaningVi: thuộc về văn hóa
words.definitionEn: tính từ; cultural differences = khác biệt văn hóa
words.exampleDailyEn: The festival celebrates the city's cultural heritage.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Travelling helps you understand cultural differences.
examples: The festival celebrates the city's cultural heritage.
Travelling helps you understand cultural differences.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; foreign currency = ngoại tệ
words.meaningVi: tiền tệ, đơn vị tiền
words.definitionEn: danh từ; foreign currency = ngoại tệ
words.exampleDailyEn: The euro is the currency of many European countries.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You can change your currency at the airport.
examples: The euro is the currency of many European countries.
You can change your currency at the airport.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ (chính); cũng là danh từ (dòng chảy, dòng điện); đồng nghĩa present
words.meaningVi: hiện tại, hiện thời
words.definitionEn: tính từ (chính); cũng là danh từ (dòng chảy, dòng điện); đồng nghĩa present
words.exampleDailyEn: What is your current address?
words.exampleIeltsEn: The current situation is better than last year.
examples: What is your current address?
The current situation is better than last year.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ; đồng nghĩa at the moment/now
words.meaningVi: hiện nay, hiện thời
words.definitionEn: trạng từ; đồng nghĩa at the moment/now
words.exampleDailyEn: She is currently working on a new novel.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The museum is currently closed for repairs.
examples: She is currently working on a new novel.
The museum is currently closed for repairs.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; draw/close the curtains = kéo rèm
words.meaningVi: rèm cửa, màn
words.definitionEn: danh từ; draw/close the curtains = kéo rèm
words.exampleDailyEn: Please close the curtains, it's getting dark.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She pulled back the curtain to look outside.
examples: Please close the curtains, it's getting dark.
She pulled back the curtain to look outside.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; it is the custom to do something; so với customs (hải quan)
words.meaningVi: phong tục, tập quán; thói quen
words.definitionEn: danh từ; it is the custom to do something; so với customs (hải quan)
words.exampleDailyEn: Shaking hands is a common custom when you meet someone.
words.exampleIeltsEn: It is a local custom to give flowers at weddings.
examples: Shaking hands is a common custom when you meet someone.
It is a local custom to give flowers at weddings.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ; không đếm được; do/cause damage to
words.meaningVi: thiệt hại, hư hại
words.definitionEn: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ; không đếm được; do/cause damage to
words.exampleDailyEn: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Smoking can damage your lungs.
examples: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
Smoking can damage your lungs.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; over the past decade = trong thập kỷ qua
words.meaningVi: thập kỷ, mười năm
words.definitionEn: danh từ; over the past decade = trong thập kỷ qua
words.exampleDailyEn: The town has changed a lot in the last decade.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She spent nearly a decade living abroad.
examples: The town has changed a lot in the last decade.
She spent nearly a decade living abroad.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; decorate something with something
words.meaningVi: trang trí, trang hoàng; sơn sửa (nhà)
words.definitionEn: động từ; decorate something with something
words.exampleDailyEn: They decorated the hall with balloons and lights.
words.exampleIeltsEn: We are going to decorate the living room this weekend.
examples: They decorated the hall with balloons and lights.
We are going to decorate the living room this weekend.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; define something as; định nghĩa một từ
words.meaningVi: định nghĩa, xác định rõ
words.definitionEn: động từ; define something as; định nghĩa một từ
words.exampleDailyEn: It's hard to define exactly what happiness is.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The dictionary defines the word very clearly.
examples: It's hard to define exactly what happiness is.
The dictionary defines the word very clearly.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; trái nghĩa với vague; a definite answer = câu trả lời dứt khoát
words.meaningVi: rõ ràng, chắc chắn, dứt khoát
words.definitionEn: tính từ; trái nghĩa với vague; a definite answer = câu trả lời dứt khoát
words.exampleDailyEn: We need a definite answer by Friday.
words.exampleIeltsEn: There has been a definite improvement in her health.
examples: We need a definite answer by Friday.
There has been a definite improvement in her health.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a definition of something; by definition = theo định nghĩa
words.meaningVi: định nghĩa, lời giải nghĩa
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a definition of something; by definition = theo định nghĩa
words.exampleDailyEn: Look up the definition of this word in the dictionary.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Everyone has a different definition of success.
examples: Look up the definition of this word in the dictionary.
Everyone has a different definition of success.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; deliver something to somebody; deliver a speech
words.meaningVi: giao hàng, phân phát; phát biểu; đỡ đẻ
words.definitionEn: động từ; deliver something to somebody; deliver a speech
words.exampleDailyEn: The shop can deliver the sofa tomorrow.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She delivered a short speech at the ceremony.
examples: The shop can deliver the sofa tomorrow.
She delivered a short speech at the ceremony.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; trái nghĩa với arrival; the departure time = giờ khởi hành
words.meaningVi: sự khởi hành, sự ra đi
words.definitionEn: danh từ; trái nghĩa với arrival; the departure time = giờ khởi hành
words.exampleDailyEn: The departure of the flight was delayed by two hours.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Check the board for the departure time of your train.
examples: The departure of the flight was delayed by two hours.
Check the board for the departure time of your train.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: giới từ; theo sau là danh từ hoặc V-ing; đồng nghĩa in spite of
words.meaningVi: mặc dù, bất chấp
words.definitionEn: giới từ; theo sau là danh từ hoặc V-ing; đồng nghĩa in spite of
words.exampleDailyEn: Despite the rain, they finished the match.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She passed the exam despite being ill.
examples: Despite the rain, they finished the match.
She passed the exam despite being ill.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a holiday destination = điểm du lịch; final destination = điểm đến cuối
words.meaningVi: điểm đến, nơi đến
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a holiday destination = điểm du lịch; final destination = điểm đến cuối
words.exampleDailyEn: Paris is a popular holiday destination.
words.exampleIeltsEn: We finally reached our destination after a long drive.
examples: Paris is a popular holiday destination.
We finally reached our destination after a long drive.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; determine the cause; determine whether/how
words.meaningVi: xác định, quyết định; định đoạt
words.definitionEn: động từ; determine the cause; determine whether/how
words.exampleDailyEn: Scientists are trying to determine the cause of the illness.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Your attitude can determine your success.
examples: Scientists are trying to determine the cause of the illness.
Your attitude can determine your success.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; determined to do something
words.meaningVi: quyết tâm, cương quyết
words.definitionEn: tính từ; determined to do something
words.exampleDailyEn: She was determined to finish the race.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He is a determined young man who never gives up.
examples: She was determined to finish the race.
He is a determined young man who never gives up.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; the development of something; recent developments = diễn biến mới
words.meaningVi: sự phát triển; sự kiện mới
words.definitionEn: danh từ; the development of something; recent developments = diễn biến mới
words.exampleDailyEn: The development of the internet changed the world.
words.exampleIeltsEn: There have been exciting developments in the case.
examples: The development of the internet changed the world.
There have been exciting developments in the case.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a diagram of/showing something
words.meaningVi: sơ đồ, biểu đồ, hình minh họa
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a diagram of/showing something
words.exampleDailyEn: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the process.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The manual includes a diagram of all the parts.
examples: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the process.
The manual includes a diagram of all the parts.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a diamond ring = nhẫn kim cương
words.meaningVi: kim cương; hình thoi
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a diamond ring = nhẫn kim cương
words.exampleDailyEn: He gave her a beautiful diamond ring.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The window had small panes in a diamond shape.
examples: He gave her a beautiful diamond ring.
The window had small panes in a diamond shape.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; have difficulty (in) doing something; with difficulty = một cách khó khăn
words.meaningVi: sự khó khăn, trở ngại
words.definitionEn: danh từ; have difficulty (in) doing something; with difficulty = một cách khó khăn
words.exampleDailyEn: She had difficulty finding a parking space.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He walked up the stairs with great difficulty.
examples: She had difficulty finding a parking space.
He walked up the stairs with great difficulty.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ; trái nghĩa với indirectly
words.meaningVi: trực tiếp; ngay lập tức; thẳng
words.definitionEn: trạng từ; trái nghĩa với indirectly
words.exampleDailyEn: You can contact the manager directly by phone.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The road leads directly to the beach.
examples: You can contact the manager directly by phone.
The road leads directly to the beach.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; không đếm được; covered in dirt = lấm bẩn
words.meaningVi: đất bẩn, bụi bẩn; đất, bùn
words.definitionEn: danh từ; không đếm được; covered in dirt = lấm bẩn
words.exampleDailyEn: His shoes were covered in dirt after the walk.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Wipe the dirt off the window before you paint it.
examples: His shoes were covered in dirt after the walk.
Wipe the dirt off the window before you paint it.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; trái nghĩa với advantage; at a disadvantage = ở thế bất lợi
words.meaningVi: điều bất lợi, mặt hạn chế
words.definitionEn: danh từ; trái nghĩa với advantage; at a disadvantage = ở thế bất lợi
words.exampleDailyEn: One disadvantage of the job is the long hours.
words.exampleIeltsEn: Not speaking the language put her at a disadvantage.
examples: One disadvantage of the job is the long hours.
Not speaking the language put her at a disadvantage.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; be disappointed with/in/about something
words.meaningVi: thất vọng, buồn vì không được như mong đợi
words.definitionEn: tính từ chỉ cảm xúc người; be disappointed with/in/about something
words.exampleDailyEn: I was disappointed with my exam results.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She looked disappointed when we cancelled the trip.
examples: I was disappointed with my exam results.
She looked disappointed when we cancelled the trip.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ mô tả sự vật/sự việc; phân biệt với disappointed (cảm xúc người)
words.meaningVi: đáng thất vọng, gây hụt hẫng
words.definitionEn: tính từ mô tả sự vật/sự việc; phân biệt với disappointed (cảm xúc người)
words.exampleDailyEn: The film was really disappointing after all the good reviews.
words.exampleIeltsEn: We had a disappointing start to the season.
examples: The film was really disappointing after all the good reviews.
We had a disappointing start to the season.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; give/get a discount on something, at a discount
words.meaningVi: sự giảm giá, chiết khấu
words.definitionEn: danh từ; give/get a discount on something, at a discount
words.exampleDailyEn: Students get a 10% discount on train tickets.
words.exampleIeltsEn: I bought these shoes at a big discount.
examples: Students get a 10% discount on train tickets.
I bought these shoes at a big discount.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ (chính); cũng là danh từ 'sự không thích'; trái nghĩa với like
words.meaningVi: không thích, ghét
words.definitionEn: động từ (chính); cũng là danh từ 'sự không thích'; trái nghĩa với like
words.exampleDailyEn: I dislike getting up early on cold mornings.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She has a strong dislike of loud music.
examples: I dislike getting up early on cold mornings.
She has a strong dislike of loud music.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; divide something into/between/among; divide by (toán học)
words.meaningVi: chia, phân chia; chia tách
words.definitionEn: động từ; divide something into/between/among; divide by (toán học)
words.exampleDailyEn: Let's divide the cake into eight pieces.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The teacher divided the class into small groups.
examples: Let's divide the cake into eight pieces.
The teacher divided the class into small groups.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; a documentary about/on something
words.meaningVi: phim tài liệu
words.definitionEn: danh từ; a documentary about/on something
words.exampleDailyEn: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa.
words.exampleIeltsEn: He is making a documentary on climate change.
examples: We watched a documentary about wild animals in Africa.
He is making a documentary on climate change.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: động từ; donate something to somebody/something
words.meaningVi: quyên góp, hiến tặng
words.definitionEn: động từ; donate something to somebody/something
words.exampleDailyEn: They donated a lot of money to the hospital.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You can donate blood twice a year.
examples: They donated a lot of money to the hospital.
You can donate blood twice a year.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ 'nghi ngờ'; have doubts about, no doubt
words.meaningVi: sự nghi ngờ, mối hoài nghi
words.definitionEn: danh từ (chính); cũng là động từ 'nghi ngờ'; have doubts about, no doubt
words.exampleDailyEn: I have no doubt that she will succeed.
words.exampleIeltsEn: There is some doubt about whether the plan will work.
examples: I have no doubt that she will succeed.
There is some doubt about whether the plan will work.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; get dressed (mặc đồ), be dressed in something
words.meaningVi: đã mặc quần áo, ăn mặc (theo kiểu nào đó)
words.definitionEn: tính từ; get dressed (mặc đồ), be dressed in something
words.exampleDailyEn: Give me five minutes to get dressed.
words.exampleIeltsEn: She was dressed in a beautiful red dress.
examples: Give me five minutes to get dressed.
She was dressed in a beautiful red dress.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; play the drums (chơi bộ trống)
words.meaningVi: cái trống
words.definitionEn: danh từ; play the drums (chơi bộ trống)
words.exampleDailyEn: He plays the drums in a local band.
words.exampleIeltsEn: The children banged on the drum all afternoon.
examples: He plays the drums in a local band.
The children banged on the drum all afternoon.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; get drunk; trái nghĩa với sober
words.meaningVi: say rượu, say xỉn
words.definitionEn: tính từ; get drunk; trái nghĩa với sober
words.exampleDailyEn: He got drunk at the party and sang loudly.
words.exampleIeltsEn: You should never drive when you are drunk.

The show looks for young musical talent.

The team is full of talented players.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1

The job requires strong technical skills.

examples: The teacher showed us a new technique for solving the problem.
She has perfect technique when she plays the violin.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1

words.exampleIeltsEn: Prices tend to rise before the holidays.
examples: People tend to eat more in winter.
Prices tend to rise before the holidays.

words.pattern: danh từ; put up/pitch a tent (dựng lều)

It started to rain, so we stayed inside the tent.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1

My bag is blue, but theirs is red.

The party had a tropical theme.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: danh từ; in theory (về lý thuyết); a theory about/of something, trái với practice

He has an interesting theory about how the universe began.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: trạng từ nối, trang trọng; thường đứng giữa hoặc đầu mệnh đề, có dấu phẩy

I don't really like coffee. I had some this morning, though.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1

He cleared his throat before he started to sing.

words.exampleIeltsEn: She stayed calm throughout the interview.

She stayed calm throughout the interview.

words.label: Từ vựng cơ bản · Bậc B1
words.pattern: tính từ; trái với loose (rộng, lỏng); trạng từ tightly

Make sure the lid is tight so nothing leaks out.

The roof of the old house was made of tin.
